content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Foreign Languages Centre Language Levels Language Levels We recommend that students use the self-assessment grid of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) as a tool to determine their proficiency level in a foreign language. Please follow this link to the official descriptor table: CEFR Self-Assessment Grid . By reflecting on the skills listed under Listening, Reading, Spoken Interaction, Spoken Production and Writing, you can identify the level (A1 – C2) that best corresponds to your current ability and better target the appropriate course for your development.
